title: Technical project manager role with salesforce
description:
Candidates must be able to talk in detail about their experience in these areas on actual projects (not just training experience)
Candidates must possess at least 7 years of project experience in the following areas:
Must have experience leading several large Salesforce implementation projects with 20+ team members
Must have broad knowledge of Salesforce including Sales, Service, Health, Experience, and Marketing Clouds. Prior experience in a healthcare insurance setting is a must .
Must have experience leading teams of remote workers including offshore and/or near-shore resources Must have demonstrable experience leading several simultaneous workstreams of varying sizes Agile methodology
Must have experience estimating work in an Agile methodology Must have familiarity with the standard Agile ceremonies
Must have familiarity with SAFe Must have solid practices for tracking, monitoring, and driving progress Must be highly flexible and adaptable. Our client's delivery processes are emerging and evolving. We have to apply our expertise, but willingly adapt to fit within the processes of the larger organization
This is a leadership position in the Center of Excellence.
The TPM will have responsibility for the day-to-day management of the CoE team members, including on-site, onshore remote, and near-shore resources.
Must have excellent communication with the ability to lead, drive, push-back, negotiate, and motivate people in a positive and constructive way. Extreme levels of organization and attention to detail are necessary to succeed in this position Preferred Qualifications
Candidates will be preferred if they possess, and can demonstrate, practical mastery in these areas Highly motivated, self-starters capable of working independently and within a larger team Highly execution-focused individuals will thrive.
The primary goal, always, is to get the work done. Candidates with proven examples of team leadership, management, motivation, and accountability are highly preferred.

title: SD25-00006 - Senior Software Engineer
description:
Under the direction of the AIS Application Services (AS) manager or delegate, the contractor shall provide one
(1) Senior Software Engineer consultant for developing, maintaining, migrating and tuning SQL Server
database environments.
The contractor will be involved in reviewing and documenting existing SQL database designs and identify areas
for improvement. Based on the suggested design and action plan, the Contractor shall perform the following
tasks and provide documentation:
A. Document the baseline of the existing databases and data mapping.
B. Optimize the query functionality and performance tuning of the database.
C. Work with business users to document business requirements related to reports and ETL (Extract Transfer
Load) process.
D. Install and administer SQL Server, SQL Server Reporting Server (SSRS) and SQL Server Integration
Services (SSIS) packages, Azure Synapse, Azure SQL.
E. Develop and implement data pipelines, data warehouses and ETL processes to integrate data from various
sources into Azure Synapse Analytics.
F. Monitor and troubleshoot issues related to SQL Server.
G. Provide knowledge transfer as defined in Knowledge Transfer section below.
